bio.text: Craig Johnson, a Republican, represents District 67 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Johnson as serving a second House term after two terms in the Iowa Senate.
The biography lists Johnson as working in business development for Larson Construction Company, Inc., and as a former member of the Vision Iowa Board.
It says Johnson graduated from Independence Jefferson Senior High School, received a B.A. in industry from the University of Northern Iowa, was born in 1963 in Independence and lives there.
